LanguageData.GravAnchor.description:
Prevents the local map from being destroyed during a gravship launch.

Grav anchors passively reduce unstable gravitation shear in a large area, which prevents the damaging effects of a gravship launch. It can't be constructed on the gravship itself because it would prevent flight entirely.

A grav anchor suppresses the launch most completely, taking priority over the stabilizing field of a grav engine: as long as the map holds a grav anchor, a launch neither abandons the map nor leaves any damage at the launch site.
